title: Encoded but Not Actionable: Auditing the Decode-Generate-Steer Gap in Frozen LLMs for Geometric Constraints
abstract: arXiv:2608.17843v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong performance on structured reasoning tasks, but what they encode and whether it informs model behavior remain unclear. We investigate this question through geometric reasoning, using parametric CAD constraints as a controlled testbed for separating local pairwise relations from sketch-level constraint status. By probing the hidden states of six frozen decoder-only LLMs, we examine four properties: linear decodability, forced-choice generation, activation-level influence, and behavioral steerability. Pretraining substantially improves the decoding of local geometric relations, and this advantage persists after accounting for positional cues with shuffled-order controls. In contrast, sketch-level DOF status is already highly decodable from randomly initialized representations and improves only modestly with pretraining, indicating that much of its probe performance is available without

translated_title: 编码但不可操作：审计冻结大语言模型中几何约束的解码-生成-转向差距
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在结构化推理任务上表现出色，但它们编码了什么以及这些编码是否影响模型行为仍不清楚。我们通过几何推理来研究这个问题，使用参数化CAD约束作为受控测试平台，以区分局部成对关系与草图级约束状态。通过探测六个冻结的仅解码器LLMs的隐藏状态，我们检查了四个属性：线性可解码性、强制选择生成、激活级影响和行为可转向性。预训练显著改善了对局部几何关系的解码，并且在用洗牌顺序控制考虑位置线索后，这种优势仍然存在。相比之下，草图级自由度状态从随机初始化的表示中已经高度可解码，预训练仅带来适度改善，表明其探测性能的很大部分无需预训练即可获得。
tldr: 该论文发现预训练提升了大语言模型对局部几何关系的解码能力，但草图级自由度状态的可解码性主要源于随机初始化表示，而非预训练，揭示了模型编码与行为之间的差距。
en_tdlr: This paper finds that pretraining enhances LLMs' decoding of local geometric relations, while sketch-level degree-of-freedom status is largely decodable from random initialization, revealing a gap between encoded knowledge and actionable behavior.
